notes: «مؤذن مسجد جردان» is a descriptor, not part of the name.
Ali speaks and is addressed inside the story; the saying («إن خليلي وابن عمك … عهد إلي») is the father's, so the father is the last link (rule 6).
«أبي» is named only by relation to Udaysa, so it is a relation link; the name is not supplied.
